name: extract-vs-fix
description: Upstream extracts the checks of register() into an exported validate(); the change tightens the email check and normalizes the address inside register(). The fix has to land in validate() as well as in register().

plan.title: Stricter, normalized emails
plan.intent: Reject addresses with spaces or several @, and register the trimmed, lower-cased address.
acceptanceCriteria: register({ email: ' Ada@Example.org ', age: 30 }) returns 'registered ada@example.org'

plan.title: Export the signup validation
plan.intent: Forms validate input before submitting; expose the checks register() does as validate().
acceptanceCriteria: validate() throws exactly what register() would
